LightningComponentBundle.description: Operator screen: assets with latest readings, severity, signal age and open interventions (US-207).

property.name: staleMinutes
property.label: Minutes before a signal is stale
property.description: A last signal older than this is flagged as stale.

property.name: autoRefreshSeconds
property.label: Refresco automático (segundos, 0 = apagado)
property.description: Refreshes the asset list in the background while it is visible. Values below 15 count as 15.
